**Draft Note to Aisha Thompson**

To: Aisha Thompson (athompson@etaconsulting.org)
Subject: Input Requested – Process Improvements Post-Sprint 19 Retrospective

Hi Aisha,

Our team held the Sprint 19 Retrospective on 2025-10-30. We identified good velocity overall, but we hit deployment issues when pushing to production on Friday. To prevent this, we've decided to implement (1) no Friday deployments and (2) mandatory smoke tests in CI.

Given your expertise as a process optimization expert at Eta Consulting, I'd appreciate your input on how to make these changes stick as we approach key Mobile App Launch milestones—specifically the Alpha Release (ms-003, planned 2026-07-15) and the Public Launch (ms-006, planned 2026-12-20).

What process improvements would you recommend we adopt now to avoid similar deployment frictions at these future stages?

Thanks for your guidance.

Best,
Alice

---
**Sources cited:**
- work_contacts.json (cnt_007): Aisha Thompson's contact info and role
- meeting_notes_365d.json (mn-2025-009): Sprint 19 Retrospective findings
- milestones_24m.json: Mobile App Launch milestones
